EXAMPLE DATASETS (js/exdata.js, js/exdata10.js, js/exdata11.js)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The published example datasets are experimental results reproduced, with their
source, only to illustrate and test the analyses. Their origin and licence:

maize4      Pérez López DJ, Saavedra Guevara C, Rubí Arriaga M, Franco Martínez JRP,
            Gutiérrez Rodríguez F, González Huerta A (2020). Revista Mexicana de
            Ciencias Agrícolas 11(4): 829–840. doi:10.29312/remexca.v11i4.2249.
            Open access, Creative Commons BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use, attribution).
hayman54    Hayman BI (1954). Biometrics 10: 235–244, Table 5. Numbers reproduced in
            Onofri A, Terzaroli N, Russi L (2021). Theoretical and Applied Genetics
            134: 585–601 (open access, CC BY 4.0).
singh8      Singh RK, Chaudhary BD (1979). Biometrical Methods in Quantitative Genetic
            Analysis. Kalyani, New Delhi. Transcription distributed under the GNU GPL.
dial2env    Zhang Y, Kang MS, Lamkey KR (2005). Agronomy Journal 97: 1097–1106; data as
            reproduced by Onofri et al. (2021), CC BY 4.0.
griffing56  Griffing B (1956). Australian Journal of Biological Sciences 9: 463–493;
            transcription distributed under the GNU GPL.
lonnquist61 Lonnquist JH, Gardner CO (1961). Crop Science 1: 179–183; Gardner CO,
            Eberhart SA (1966). Biometrics 22: 439–452; reproduced by Onofri et al. (2021).
partial8    Jasso-Bobadilla G, González-Huerta A, Pérez-López DJ, Franco-Martínez JRP,
            Rubí-Arriaga M, Mejía-Carranza J (2022). Revista Mexicana de Ciencias
            Agrícolas 13(1): 41–52. doi:10.29312/remexca.v13i1.3097. CC BY-NC 4.0.
nc1, nc3,   Singh RK, Chaudhary BD (1979), op. cit.; transcriptions distributed under
lxt         the GNU GPL.
nc2         International Potato Center (CIP), locality Majes, Peru; distributed under
            the GNU GPL.
maize13,    Maize hybrids evaluated for 15 ear and plant traits (one and four
maize13env  environments), distributed by their author, T. Olivoto, with free software
            under the GNU GPL v3.
oat14       Oat genotypes in 14 environments, distributed by their author, T. Olivoto,
            with free software under the GNU GPL v3.
plrv28      International Potato Center (CIP), Lima, Peru: clones of the PLRV population
            in Ayacucho, Huancayo, La Molina and San Ramón (2002–2003); distributed with
            free software under the GNU GPL.
stb17       Kang MS (1993). Agronomy Journal 85: 754–757; Kang MS, Magari R (1995).
            Agronomy Journal 87: 276–277. Example data distributed with free software
            under the GNU GPL.
gale77      Gale JS, Mather K, Jinks JL (1977). Heredity 38: 47–51, Table 1, set 1.
            Only the published statistics (n, mean and variance of every generation)
            are used; the values per plant were rebuilt by BreedingPro with those
            exact moments.
mrode31,    Mrode RA (2014). Linear Models for the Prediction of Animal Breeding
mrode52     Values, 3rd ed. CABI, Wallingford: examples 3.1 and 3.2 and the common
            litter environment example; small textbook examples reproduced for
            validation, with their source.
schaeffer31, Schaeffer LR (2019). Animal Models. University of Guelph: Tables 3.1 and
schaeffer61 6.1–6.2; small textbook examples reproduced for validation, with their source.
wheatMarkers, Crossa J et al. (2010). Genetics 186: 713–724. Data of the International
wheatPheno  Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT) distributed with free software
            under the GNU GPL.
technowMarkers, Technow F et al. (2014). Genetics 197: 1343–1355. Data distributed with
technowPheno free software under the GNU GPL; 2000 of the 35 478 SNP are included.

Crossbreeding examples of Block 10 (js/block10.js): the two-breed diallel of
van der Werf J, Crossbreeding (GENE251/351 lecture notes, lecture 20, University of
New England); the published parameters of Tesema Z et al. (2023), PLOS ONE 18:
e0291996 (CC BY 4.0); and the breed means and heterosis percentages of example 2 of
Buchanan DS, Northcutt SL, Genetic principles of crossbreeding, Beef Cattle Handbook
BCH-1400. Only a few published numbers are used, with their source.

simAlpha,   Simulated by BreedingPro with fixed seeds (js/examples.js, js/exdata10.js,
simGen,     js/genomic11.js, js/cross10.js); no third-party rights.
simTTC,
simLines
